fato_historico: 1917: Anti-lynching movement: The Silent Parade takes place in New York City, in protest against murders, lynchings, and other violence directed towards African Americans.
energia_do_dia: Today, the celestial tides invite you to honor your sensitive spirit. Much like the historic silent voices that marched for justice and dignity, you may find your own quiet power resonating with deep empathy. It is a good time to protect your emotional sanctuary while perhaps radiating warmth to those seeking comfort in your gentle, protective embrace.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle heart is a lighthouse guiding others toward a safer, kinder shore.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between emotional intuition and collective harmony.
conselho: Stand tall in your values and offer kindness to yourself and your community.
